//DATABASE: Local sandbox only. 'hrport_live' is a LOCAL database on this machine at
schema version V154, which is what the Spring Boot code expects. Despite
its name it is NOT the hosted production server: that one is named in the
repository .env, and nothing in this solution points at it.
ConnectionLifeTime is 30s to match the hosted MySQL's wait_timeout, and the
pool is small because that account is capped across every process using it.
Both are the same reasons the Java Hikari pool is tuned the way it is.

Jwt.//: Local development key only. Production supplies App__Jwt__Secret from the environment, and it must match the Spring backend's APP_JWT_SECRET while both run.
